name: Projected Terminal Find Surface
description: Provides compact, bounded, keyboard-first search of retained content for one projected terminal client.

states: Inspect deterministic compact result, searching, and expanded invalid-expression states with localized status output.

Use the selection-seeded query field, embedded option toggles and their keys, Up and Down match navigation, match navigation controls, repeated-open selection, and Escape focus restoration entirely by keyboard.
Inspect the compact zero-result count without an unnecessary second status row.

useWhen: A single projected terminal client must search only content retained by its Terminal Host attachment.
avoidWhen: Search spans Workbench Actions, settings, projects, or multiple providers instead of one terminal buffer.
invariants: Opening the surface does not create a search Worker until a non-empty query survives the debounce.
Search status never exposes raw terminal content or engine error text as product-facing copy.
Ordinary progress stays in the compact toolbar while actionable errors and retained-history notices remain fully visible.
Every open or repeated open replaces any query with the current active selection's bounded preview; without one, it preserves the query, then focuses and selects the complete query.
Left and Right Arrow move among embedded option toggles, while pointer option changes restore query focus.
Up and Down in the query field go to the previous and next match exactly as Shift+Enter and Enter do; the surface keeps no query history.

While the surface has focus, Alt+C, Alt+W, and Alt+R on Standard and Option+Cmd+C, Option+Cmd+W, and Option+Cmd+R on Apple toggle Match case, Match whole word, and Use regular expression without moving focus, and each toggle's tooltip shows its key.
Closing the surface restores terminal focus.
